subject: Security walkthrough — cross-timezone slot + resilience plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@finserve.com>, Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@finserve.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Apr 2029 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Security walkthrough — cross-timezone slot + resilience plan

Hi Marta / Liam —

Thanks again for the interest in Redwood. We're excited to run the SOC 2 + DPA walkthrough and a short pen-test readiness overview. To make scheduling smoother across your EU team and our US ops, can we propose two compact options: 

1) Single 90-minute session: 08:00–09:30 BST (UTC+1) on Thu 18 Apr — covers control mapping, live demo, and DPA Q&A.
2) Split sessions over two days (preferred for cross-region):
   • Day 1 (technical demo & pen scope): 16 Apr 17:00–17:45 PT / 01:00–01:45 BST next day
   • Day 2 (legal & DPA review): 18 Apr 09:30–10:15 BST

If neither fits, we can run a 45-minute canary technical session the evening before and then a 60-minute legal deep-dive during your business hours.

I've attached a short evidence checklist (SOC2) and a one-pager DPA summary to help orient attendees. Can you share who from your security and legal teams will join, and which option you'd prefer?

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-soc2-evidence-checklist.pdf (PDF, 420KB), dpa-summary-2029-04.pdf (PDF, 95KB)

From: Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@finserve.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@finserve.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Apr 2029 00:24:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Security walkthrough — cross-timezone slot + resilience plan

Ben —

Appreciate the options. Quick notes from our side:
- Security (me) and Legal (Liam) are the core attendees; we may bring one infra engineer.
- Single 90-minute session is hard for our legal folks in the morning due to calendar conflicts. The split over two days looks doable but we prefer the technical demo not to land at 01:00 BST (that'll be midnight for our engineer).

Could you propose a split that keeps the technical demo in an evening slot that is US-friendly but not past midnight for EU? For example:
  • Day 1 technical: 18 Apr 19:00–19:45 PT / 03:00–03:45 BST — still a bit late.
  • Alternative: 17 Apr 18:00–18:45 PT / 02:00–02:45 BST — also late.

If we can't find overlap without pushing someone very late, we'd like to do: a recorded quick technical demo (pre-recorded 20-min) + live 60-min DPA/legal session at 09:30 BST on 18 Apr.

Can you confirm if a pre-recorded demo is acceptable and whether you can do the live DPA session on 18 Apr at 09:30 BST? Also please confirm what evidence we should prepare in advance.

— Marta
Marta Alvarez | Head of Security, FinServe
attachments: none

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@finserve.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@finserve.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Apr 2029 02:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security walkthrough — cross-timezone slot + resilience plan

Marta — thanks for the clear constraints. Pre-recorded technical demos are fine and we often do them for timezone-challenged stakeholders. Proposal:

A) We will record a focused 20-minute demo (live-feel format) covering runtime isolation, network controls, and model version pinning. We'll share the recording and a timestamped Q&A doc the evening before.
B) Live DPA/legal session: Thu 18 Apr 09:30–10:30 BST — extended to 60 minutes to cover redlines. Redwood legal (Olga) and product-security (Jasmine) will join.
C) Resilience plan: if there are open technical questions after the live session, we'll run a 30-minute follow-up with an engineer within 48 hours (can be asynchronous via recorded answers if preferred).

Evidence to prepare (short list):
- Primary contact for audit (name + email)
- High-level network diagram (redacted ok)
- Data retention policy excerpt relevant to embeddings (if applicable)
- Any contractual redlines specific to logging/audit latency

I'll get the recording produced by Wed evening PT and share the Drive link. Olga / Jasmine — can you confirm you'll be available for 18 Apr 09:30 BST?

Ben
attachments: none

Subject: Re: Security walkthrough — cross-timezone slot + resilience plan

Ben / Team —

Confirmed: I'll join live for the 18 Apr 09:30 BST DPA session. Jasmine will join the walkthrough and can present the runtime separation slides and SOC 2 control owners. Ben — please include the Zoom bridge and the Drive link to the recording in the invite.

Also suggested prep for FinServe to speed redlines: if you can send your standard DPA mark-up guidance and any common exceptions we see (short bullets), it makes the 60-minute legal session far more efficient.

Olga
Olga Petrov | Legal Ops, Redwood Inference

Thanks — this works for us. Confirming:
- We accept the recorded technical demo (please share link by Wed 17 Apr 22:00 BST).
- Live DPA/legal session: Thu 18 Apr 09:30–10:30 BST (we'll invite our legal counsel + one engineer).

Action items:
- Ben: calendar invite + Zoom bridge + Drive links
- Ben / Olga: send DPA guidance and expected redline bullets before the call
- FinServe: we'll upload the high-level network diagram to your shared folder by EOD Wed.

We'll see you Thursday.

Best,
Marta
